## WHAT HOTEL ETUNA IS

Hotel Etuna is a **single-property operating system** — not a generic multi-property PMS. It is the **hub tenant** of a hub-and-spoke hospitality platform (`buffr-host`). The product surfaces are:

1. **Public guest website** (`hoteletuna.com`) — rooms, dining menu (browse/view), partner directory, Sofia AI widget (rate-gated)
2. **Staff dashboard** — PMS, bookings, housekeeping, restaurant ops, payments desk, CRM, analytics
3. **Guest hub** (`/guest`) — self-service for travellers (stays, folio, loyalty, payment)
4. **Partner portals** — lightweight self-service for JayLa Accommodation and Aquarius (no AI, no CRM)
5. **Buffr platform console** (`/admin/platform`) — super-admin for cross-tenant oversight

**The single property:** Hotel Etuna, 5544 Valley Street, Ongwediva, Namibia. **35 guest rooms** in 5 marketing categories (Standard A/B/C, Executive, Premiere) plus **Conference Hall** and **Campsite** bookable online. 1 restaurant (Etuna Restaurant, 12 categories, 110+ live menu items). Check-in 14:00, check-out 11:00. Phone +264 65 231 177.

**Inventory OS wiring (2026-06-04):** `lib/data/hotel-etuna-room-inventory.ts` → migrations `0040`–`0043` + `scripts/seed-hotel-etuna.ts`. Public: `/rooms`, `/facilities/*`. Staff: `/bookings` hub calendar (`BookingsOperationsHub`), kind badges, `/bookings/new` tabs. Downstream: `lib/bookings/booking-kind.ts`, folio charges, analytics occupancy (35 guest rooms), intelligence digest by kind, accounting P&L conference/campsite lines, Sofia/KB guest_room filter. See `docs/project/ROOM_INVENTORY.md`.

**Production URL:** https://www.hoteletuna.com (Vercel + Neon PostgreSQL)

## 9. Sofia AI Architecture

- **LLM:** DeepSeek primary (`AI_PROVIDER_ORDER=deepseek,openai,anthropic,llm`)
- **RAG:** Qdrant Cloud Inference (`intfloat/multilingual-e5-small`, 384d), collection `buffr_rag`
- **Knowledge base:** 4 markdown files, ~27 chunks (`hotel-etuna-facts.md`, `room-descriptions.md`, `restaurant-menu.md`, `local-area.md`)
- **Conversations:** Persisted in Neon (`ai_conversations` + `ai_messages`)
- **Guest memory:** Neon `crm_guest_memory_facts` + `crm_graph_edges` (written after each turn)
- **Gating:** Sofia will NOT disclose rates to unauthenticated users
- **Hub-exclusive:** All AI endpoints middleware-blocked for partner tenants (403)
- **Ingest command:** `npm run rag:seed`
